title: COMP 3721 · Midterm
subtitle: Thu Oct 29, 11:00, 120 minutes: Lecture Notes 01 to 07 and the textbook chapters; calculator and two double-sided cheat sheets
description: The instructor's Suggested Midterm Review Topics worked one by one, with you computing before every reveal: each item mapped to the lesson that teaches it, the differences the review list flags (Nyquist vs Shannon, the three formulas that start with 2, digital-to-analog vs analog-to-analog), every calculation type in one mixed drill where you pick the formula first, cross-week problems, a 120-minute mock midterm in the sample-quiz shapes (true or false, fill in the blanks, written response, calculations), and a four-side cheat-sheet draft for Weeks 1 to 7.
intro:
:::quiz Midterm facts
**Thursday Oct 29 2026, 11:00, 120 minutes, on paper.** Worth **30%**; you need a **50% average across the midterm and the final** to pass the course, and there are no make-ups. Covers **Lecture Notes 01 to 07 plus the textbook chapters** (Ch 1 to 3). Bring a calculator with a log key and **two double-sided A4 or Letter cheat sheets**, handwritten or printed. The only sample of the instructor's style is the Sample Quiz Questions sheet: true or false, fill in the blanks (graded against the slide's exact words) and short written responses; expect calculations with units as in every lab quiz. The review list's own warning: Nyquist has a factor of 2 and Shannon does not.
:::
